<finding task="2"><quote>`uv.toml` (repo root) | `exclude-newer` set to the RFC 3339 timestamp of 00:00:00Z on the day after the freeze date | Every `uv run` from the repo root resolves as of the freeze date, script headers included. Files uploaded on the freeze date itself (UTC) are included.</quote><plan>    @property
    def cutoff(self) -> str:
        '''00:00:00Z on the freeze date, so uv resolves as of the start of that day.'''
        return f'{self.freeze:%Y-%m-%d}T00:00:00Z'</plan><fix>Return 00:00:00Z on `freeze + 1 day`. Change the Task 2 test to `assert versions.parse(GOOD).cutoff == '2026-10-20T00:00:00Z'` and the 2026-12-31 case to `'2027-01-01T00:00:00Z'`. Make the same change to every expected cutoff string in Tasks 3, 5, 7 and 8, and in the `uv.toml` comment in `outputs()`, which should read "files uploaded on the freeze date (UTC) are included". `late_pins` then flags only uploads made after the freeze day, so its test should treat `2026-10-19T23:00Z` as not late and `2026-10-20T00:00Z` as late.</fix></finding>
